questions.input: How many CIS Controls are in Version 8?
questions.expected_output: There are 18 CIS Controls in Version 8.
context: Introduction / Structure of the CIS Controls
questions.evaluation_notes: A direct lookup. A good RAG system should retrieve the controls list and count accurately.

questions.input: What does IG1 stand for and what type of enterprise does it target?
questions.expected_output: IG1 stands for Implementation Group 1. It targets small to medium-sized enterprises with limited IT and cybersecurity expertise. These enterprises have a limited tolerance for downtime and primarily protect employee and financial information.
questions.evaluation_notes: Tests direct retrieval of IG definition.

questions.input: What is the minimum password length recommended for accounts not using MFA?
questions.expected_output: A minimum of 14 characters is recommended for accounts not using MFA. For accounts using MFA, the minimum is 8 characters.
questions.evaluation_notes: Numerical detail extraction. Hallucination risk if model relies on general knowledge.

questions.input: After how many days of inactivity should a dormant account be disabled?
questions.expected_output: Dormant accounts should be deleted or disabled after 45 days of inactivity.
questions.evaluation_notes: Specific threshold value. Good test for numeric grounding.

questions.input: What is the maximum session inactivity timeout for mobile end-user devices?
questions.expected_output: For mobile end-user devices, automatic session locking must be configured to trigger after no more than 2 minutes of inactivity. For general purpose operating systems, the maximum is 15 minutes.
context: Safeguard 4.3 — Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets
questions.evaluation_notes: Two values in one safeguard — tests if model retrieves both.
